Tamil Nadu Announces Special Bus Services for Festivals

Tamil Nadu has announced special bus services and temporary bus terminals to manage the rush during the Ayudha Pooja and Deepavali festivals. The Tamil Nadu State Transport Corporation (TNSTC) will operate these services.
